title: Tech Note: 4D on GitHub
author: Ayoub Khali, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This is a foundational note on 4D Project Mode + Git that remains highly relevant: Project Mode (introduced experimentally in v17R5 as described here) went on to become the standard, default development mode in 4D v18+ and later, fully superseding classic binary-mode (.4DB) team development workflows. The general Git/GitHub instructions are still accurate, though some UI screenshots (GitHub signup flow, installer links) will be visually outdated.
related_updates: 4D Project Mode became the standard, default project format starting v18 (with binary/.4DB Design Mode now considered legacy)
4D has since published more detailed Project Mode + Git integration guidance and tooling (e.g., improved diff-friendly file formats) as the format matured
